environment.description: Self-hosted Jenkins runner on EC2 (Amazon Linux 2), running pipeline jobs with default configuration. Plugin loaded with PIPELINE_CONFIG pointing to config file where feature_flags is empty dict {}. No LaunchDarkly SDK integration configured. The extractor runs as jenkins user with write access to /var/lib/jenkins and /tmp. Artifact zips are pulled from an S3 bucket that any authenticated IAM principal in the org can write to.
